html:
Here is the galaxy NGC463 located about 30 light-years away in the constellation Canes Venatici. It is seen edge-on. It has a companion, NGC4627, located just above it.

This is first light for this newly acquired telescope (AT8RC). 



The technical details
Date:  2011/04/30
Optical train = AT8RC @ F8 - AT2FF - IDAS-LPS filter - Canon xsi unfiltered
Mount: Takahashi EM-200 Temma II driven with the TheSky6 software and guided with phd, QHY5 and 50mm finder
Acquisition with BackyardEOS
Site: At home
33 exposures of 5 min for 165 minutes
Flat and bias applied
Pre-processing and processing in PixInsight
